summary: Block 10: analysis only; frozen revision untouched (no generator, no build). Wrote EQUIVALENCE.md, the referee-facing argument. P is the coefficient map - the only object hwild sees, and the one needing measurability because it is pushed forward; S is a read-out with no structure, occurring only as H i (S x). The unification is not 'ambient is a special case of finite' but 'the proof used only these two slots': the bodies differ in 6 lines and, after deleting the two local P/hP bindings, q and hq vanish from the proof. Every old hypothesis is tabulated with its new location; nothing is dropped, reordered or strengthened; the only renamed item is hq to hP, which the old proofs already built. def-to-abbrev preservation is argued in three steps (identical binders; body defeq by one delta and one beta, alpha on the bound variable; abbrev merely widens transparency), and no proof depends on unfolding either name (seven occurrences, none in simp/rw/unfold, no attribute). No measurability on S is dropped: it would be unused, the old statements were equally silent about H, and both instances supply measurable S. Zero new assumptions. -126 stays textual.
verified_results: [verified here, source reading] Seven occurrences of the two names exist in the whole tree (ConditionalSpectrum 267, 284, 323; ConditionalLimits 227, 369, 398, 592), each either the declaration, an application in a hypothesis slot, or the conclusion of a construction lemma; none is reached by simp, rw, unfold, or any attribute. So no existing proof depends on unfolding either definition, and def -> abbrev cannot perturb one.

[verified here, source reading] P/S decomposition from the proof text: the only role of q in the finite body was the deleted line 'let P : X -> W := q circ p', and of hq the deleted 'have hP : Measurable P := hq.comp hp'; after deletion no occurrence of q or hq remains. In the ambient body the same two lines read 'let P : X -> W := q' and 'have hP : Measurable P := hq'.

[verified here, source reading] def -> abbrev meaning preservation: binders identical (same names, order, explicitness, types, instance argument), bodies defeq by one delta on the alias plus one beta on (fun x => q (p x)) x resp. id x, bound variable renamed alpha-only. Type of the constant unchanged, so all applications including the construction lemmas at ConditionalLimits:227 and :592 keep meaning.

[verified here, source reading] Quantified public statements preserved as terms: binder text byte-identical (statement hashes 2dde28358ab09934 and ab6dd548d3a6bb53) and hypothesis types unchanged by the alias, so the propositions are the same terms, not merely equivalent; the only caveat is that #check may print the alias unfolded.

[verified here, source reading] Why S needs no measurability: S occurs only inside H i (S x); the pointwise bound transfers with no regularity on S; Integrable and the integral are assumed of the composite, never derived. The old definitions were equally silent about H (no Measurable hypothesis on H either), and at both instances S is measurable anyway (hp, id). Adding a hypothesis on S would be unused, which the no-new-assumptions rule forbids.
